capabilities: Toggle navigation arrow visibility for left, right, up, and down movement
Choose slide transition effects (none, fade, slide)
Adjust progress bar height, footer text, and slide number placement
Left-align lists and auto-fit overflowing slide content
Navigate slides with WASD/QE keyboard shortcuts
disambiguation: Not a presentation creator; it only customizes the behavior and styling of the existing Slides core plugin.
extras: Requires the Slides core plugin to be enabled; the README warns about this explicitly.
intentEvidence: This plugin allows you to customize the Slides Obsidian core plugin.
problem: The core Slides plugin offers little control over navigation arrows, transition effects, progress bar, and slide layout during presentations.
summary: Settings add-on that customizes the built-in Slides core plugin's navigation, transitions, and slide appearance.
